I've fixed the `wrap` function in `src/wrap.py`. The issue was that the original code used `width - 1` as the limit when checking if a word fits on a line, which prevented words from exactly filling a line. 

The fix was to change the condition from `len(cur) + extra > width - 1` to `len(cur) + extra > width`. Since the `extra` calculation already includes the space between words (adding 1 when there's existing content), using `width` as the limit ensures that words can be added if the total length including spaces fits within the specified width.

All 5 tests now pass.
